Houston - we have a trend! 

Do you get the feeling the US Congress is full of a bunch of do nothing, lay about, shiftless slackers? Apparently it might be true!

The 119th US Congress enacted 121 laws since it convened in January 2025 - the 2nd  fewest of any Congress in the past four decades. Only the 118th  Congress (the previous one) had enacted fewer laws (106) by this point in its two-year term. https://www.pewresearch.org/short-reads/2026/10/15/so-far-the-119th-congress-is-among-the-least-productive-of-the-past-40-years/  #Government #USCongress #USGov #Congress #Laws #Washington #Productivity #Slackers #Lazy #PewResearch #Regulation
